reviews.text: this is a great app! i started using it for marching band and it has been great! it’s so fun that you can upload photos and videos to your groups. it is a little hard to delete your pfp so they start to pile up, but once you figure it out it’s pretty easy. you go to your one of you bands, click on you in the band, click the three dots when on you pfp, then click delete. tada! hope this helped!

reviews.title: Screen sharing
reviews.text: This app is good overall but I have two complaints. One is that you are not able to screenshare on the app which is annoying because I want to be able to show the person I’m calling what I see without screenshotting it and sending it to them. Two is that the call only last an hour. Please make calls last how long they want. Thank you please read this and make a couple changes

reviews.title: Flooded with Korean Advertising…
reviews.text: Initially, I found it to be a valuable tool; however, it has recently been inundated with Korean language advertisements that are completely unrelated to the Band. As a result, the platform has become impractical. I am hesitant to continue using it unless absolutely necessary. I am perplexed as to why others have rated it so highly.

reviews.title: User beware- especially if you have kids
reviews.text: I’m assuming the majority of users use this app to organize their children’s activities. Before you do- please know that there is little security. No support if your account gets hacked. No accountability. Role the dice and use this app.
